train_model: train a ParlAI model by running a TrainLoop with the given opt configuration
eval_model: evaluate a ParlAI model on validation and test splits using the eval_model script
display_data: display ParlAI task data for train, valid, and test splits and capture output
display_model: run display_model to show model predictions on train, valid, and test splits
capture_output: capture stdout and stderr into a StringIO buffer using a context manager
